A1: Very short, simple main clauses in the present tense. The most common 500 words. Repeat key words naturally. Avoid subordinate clauses, Perfekt only for very common verbs, no Präteritum except war/hatte.
A2: Short sentences, simple connectors (und, aber, oder, weil, dass). Everyday vocabulary. Perfekt for the past, Präteritum only for sein, haben and modal verbs. Explain any less common word through context.
B1: Clear standard German with some subordinate clauses (weil, obwohl, als, wenn, damit, relative clauses). Perfekt and Präteritum, simple Konjunktiv II (würde, hätte, wäre). Common vocabulary plus topic words, each new topic word explained by context. Avoid idioms that a B1 learner would not know, or explain them.
B2: Natural standard German with varied sentence structure, Passiv, Konjunktiv II and some indirekte Rede. A broad vocabulary including common idioms. Explain only rare or technical terms.
C1: Rich, natural German as in a quality radio programme: complex sentences, nuanced vocabulary, idioms, Konjunktiv I in reported speech.
C2: Unrestricted native-level German, including sophisticated vocabulary, wordplay and stylistic variety.
